entities.name: Abolition of School Corporal Punishment
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: For millennia, beating children was considered essential education — "spare the rod, spoil the child." Poland banned school corporal punishment in 1783 (the first country). Sweden banned all corporal punishment of children in 1979. As of 2024, 65 countries have banned it entirely. The US still permits it in 17 states.
